description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -  Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District   - Cad. Map. No. 320552  and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details) in Kiribathkumbura. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
